title: Aagaya shame ghariban
body:
Aagae shame gariban Aagae shame gariban
Binte zahra ne pukara
Qasime nausha kaha ho ho kaha kadiyal jawan
Marna jau aye khudara
Aagae shame.....
Do Ghadi chehra dikha do aye jari aye bawafa
Ma ka mushkil hai guzara
Aagae shame....
Ashk ankho se utar kar keh rahe the khaak se
Alqama ka woh qinara
Aagae shame....
Qafla chalne laga to di sada sajjad ne
Beridae ne hai mara
Aagae shame....
Boli zainab dekh ke yawar sare shabbir ko
Hai ye zahra ka dulara
Aagae shame...
